title: Software Engineer, Data
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Us</strong></h2> <p>Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.&nbsp; Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.</p> <p>In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.</p> <p>Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: <strong>Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship</strong>.</p></div><h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">As a member of the Data team, you will help build the services, infrastructure, and data platforms that power our business. Our team&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">is responsible for</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing"> ingesting, processing, storing, and distributing large volumes of data reliably and efficiently, enabling teams across the business to make data-driven decisions and build innovative products.</span></span> <span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335551550&quot;:6,&quot;335551620&quot;:6}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">This role sits at the intersection of backend software engineering and data engineering, with an emphasis on data engineering. You will build and </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">maintain</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing"> data pipelines, develop backend services for data ingestion and access, and contribute to the data infrastructure that enables reliable, cost-effective, and high-performance data processing.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335551550&quot;:6,&quot;335551620&quot;:6}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">You'll</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing"> work closely with software engineers, DevOps engineers, product managers, data consumers, and more experienced colleagues, who will provide guidance, code reviews, and support as you grow. title: Operations & Strategy Manager - Energy Markets
description: Operations & Strategy Manager Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ) Our mission for you European energy costs are twice as high as in the US and China, and electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. This puts European industry under massive cost pressure – and companies need to act now. trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that brings together energy procurement, energy management and the marketing of flexible assets in one product. This helps companies save up to 30% on their recurring electricity costs while switching to renewable energy. We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast – the market window is open and we intend to own it. Now we are looking for an Operations & Strategy Manager to own a business-critical part of our energy value chain: the processes behind how we configure, price and quote long-term energy products for our customers. About trawa trawa is a tech-driven scale-up based in Berlin with around 100 employees, combining deep energy market expertise with in-house software development. We've raised over €35M to date, most recently a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic and Tiny VC. This role is based in our Berlin office, where we work together in person most of the week. We offer flexible working hours, so you can shape your day in a way that works for you. The Team You'll join our Energy & Trading team, which owns the energy side of our business – from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll report directly to our Energy & Trading Manager and work closely with the COO, our Trading Team, Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: own our CPQ process end-to-end and grow the margin it generates. Who we are looking for Strong quantitative skills: You think analytically, feel at home with numbers and data and can confidently challenge quantitative results – without having to be a quant or developer yourself. Ideally, you have a degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g. economics, engineering, industrial engineering, business administration). Business acumen & process mindset: You think commercially, care about margins and unit economics, enjoy turning messy processes into robust, scalable ones and prioritise by impact. Experience with commercial processes such as pricing or deal desks, in energy, financial services or any other industry, is a plus. Interest in energy markets: You are fascinated by how energy markets work – from wholesale and forward markets to PPAs, hedging and pricing – and want to dive deep into them. Knowledge of the German energy market is a plus; experience in (energy) trading is explicitly not required – what matters is your drive to understand the mechanics and make the processes behind them work. Hungry & ambitious: You want to grow fast, take on responsibility early and set high standards for yourself. You don't wait for instructions and enjoy a steep learning curve, and work experience in a high-paced environment, e.g. a start-up, scale-up or consulting, is a plus. High ownership & structured execution: You drive topics end-to-end, align stakeholders across departments and turn ideas into scalable processes with tangible business impact. An affinity for AI-powered tools and automation to make processes faster and smarter is a plus. Strong communication: You speak German at native level and very good English, and you translate confidently between commercial, quantitative and operational perspectives. What you'll do As Operations & Strategy Manager, you combine a strong analytical mind with process excellence and commercial drive: Own our CPQ process: You take end-to-end ownership of our CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) processes for long-term energy products – from the customer request through pricing and offer creation to trade execution, across Sales, Pricing, Trading and Operations and for all our customer segments. You make this process faster, more robust and scalable. Stabilise and grow our margins: Our customers hedge their energy costs with long-term products from us, such as PPAs and Futures/Forwards. You are responsible for stabilising our margins on these hedges and increasing them in the medium term – covering a multi-million euro gross margin. Pave the way to more complex products: Over the past three years, we have shown that we can profitably price, buy and sell energy. You build on that foundation and develop our long-term offering towards more complex, higher-margin products that fit our customers' needs even better. Bridge between trading and business: You work closely with our quant trading and data science team and turn their models and insights into processes and systems that work across teams and markets – so that pricing, risk and market insights reliably translate into better decisions and products for our customers. 90 Day Goals After 6 Weeks (Onboarding): Business understanding: You have understood trawa's business, product and energy value chain in detail and got to know all relevant internal and external stakeholders. Portfolio knowledge: You understand our long-term product portfolio (PPAs, Futures/Forwards), our customers' hedging needs and how pricing, margins and risk come together in our offers. CPQ mapping: You have mapped our current CPQ process – from customer request and pricing to offer creation and trade execution – and identified the key pain points and margin levers. Month 3 (Ramp-Up): Go-to CPQ owner: You are the go-to person for our CPQ process and have implemented first improvements that make it faster and more robust. Margin transparency: You have created transparency on our margins across long-term hedges and derived first measures to stabilise them. Target process: You have designed a target CPQ process, started its implementation and proposed first, more complex products for our long-term offering. Why us? Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity – most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your work will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now. Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level. Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning and career progression. Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events. At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity. Über Buena Buena übernimmt Hausverwaltungen und digitalisiert sie mit selbst entwickelter Software. Gemeinsam mit unserem M&A-Anwalt bereitest du die finanziellen und operativen Anlagen zum Kaufvertrag vor und stellst sicher, dass die Angaben stimmen. Für die Qualität einstehen. Du prüfst die Beiträge unserer Praktikant, erkennst Fehler frühzeitig und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fertige Analyse. Den Prozess weiterentwickeln. Du lernst unsere Playbooks kennen, setzt sie sorgfältig um und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Datenräume, Analysen und Entscheidungen besser organisieren können. Idealerweise bringst du ein bis zwei Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst im Transaktionsumfeld, bei Private Equity oder Venture Capital mit. Auch fundierte Praktikumserfahrung kann relevant sein. Entscheidend ist, wie tief du in die Arbeit eingestiegen bist und welche Verantwortung du dir jetzt zutraust. Deine analytischen Grundlagen sitzen. Du bist sicher in Excel, kannst Finanzdaten interpretieren und verstehst Bewertungskonzepte wie Equity Bridge und Discounted-Cashflow-Analyse. Du den entscheidenden Details nachgehst. Eine Zahl, die sich nicht nachvollziehen lässt, oder eine Vertragsklausel mit unerwarteten Folgen ist für dich ein Grund, genauer hinzusehen. Du dein Urteil erklären kannst. Du gehst souverän mit Rückfragen um, unterscheidest belastbare Erkenntnisse von Annahmen und änderst deine Einschätzung, wenn neue Informationen es erfordern. Du Verantwortung übernimmst. Du hältst den Prozess in Bewegung, verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent und holst dir Unterstützung, wenn sie gebraucht wird. Du dich in einem direkten, informellen Umfeld wohlfühlst. Du bringst sorgfältiges Arbeiten aus dem Transaktionsumfeld in ein Startup ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten. Die Besonderheiten von Hausverwaltungen und unsere internen Abläufe kannst du bei uns lernen. Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung. Warum Buena Früh eigene Verantwortung übernehmen. Du begleitest deine Targets durch die Due Diligence und stehst für die Ergebnisse ein. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in konkrete Kaufentscheidungen ein. Direkt mit den Entscheidungsträgern arbeiten. Du präsentierst im Investment Committee und arbeitest eng mit Kolleg aus M&A, Legal und Operations zusammen. Mit jeder Transaktion dazulernen. Unsere volle Pipeline bietet dir immer wieder die Gelegenheit, Unternehmen zu verstehen, Risiken zu bewerten und zu sehen, wie deine Erkenntnisse einen Deal beeinflussen. Mitgestalten wie wir Unternehmen kaufen. Unser Prozess ist strukturiert und lässt sich weiter verbessern. Sobald du ihn kennst, hast du den Freiraum, einzelne Schritte zu hinterfragen und bessere Lösungen vorzuschlagen. So lernen wir uns kennen Wir sprechen über deine Transaktionserfahrung, deine Herangehensweise an Due Diligence und die Verantwortung, die du als Nächstes übernehmen möchtest. Anschließend bearbeitest du einen praxisnahen Case und lernst das Team kennen, auch bei einem gemeinsamen Mittag- oder Abendessen. Referenzgespräche sind Teil der abschließenden Phase. Du möchtest die Due Diligence hinter Buenas nächsten Akquisitionen verantworten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Senior Service Reliability Engineer</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">As a part of Sony Interactive Entertainment, the Gaming,<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><span class="searchHighlight">Developer</span><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>&amp; Future<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><span class="searchHighlight">Technology Group</span> (<span data-teams="true">GDFT</span>) is leading the cloud gaming revolution, putting console-quality video games on any device, from TVs to consoles to mobile devices and beyond.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Our Site Reliability Engineering team plays a significant role in delivering on the promise of a great cloud gaming experience to our customers. The successful candidate will be self-directed and able to participate in the way we make decisions at different levels.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We expect our SREs to have opinions on the state of our service and provide critical feedback during different phases of the operational lifecycle. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession.

Learn how a global trading business really works, and build the AI tools that make it faster.

As a Forward Deployed Intern, you spend six months inside our business. You sit with the teams that buy, sell and move industrial materials, learn how their work really happens, and build tools that make it faster, with AI at the core.

Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world. We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward. At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward. When our customers, self-employed people and small business owners, do need help, it should come fast: from self-service and AI first, and from a person when that's what the case needs. We're bringing our support tooling, Zendesk, chatbots and AI work together into one team with one backlog and one roadmap. As Senior Product Owner, you'll lead that team and own the outcome: more questions answered by AI, faster help, lower cost to serve, and customers who still trust us. You'll also shape where this goes next. Over the next couple of years AI will handle more and more first-line support, and you'll decide how the work is split between AI and people, and build the platform around it. A clear point of view on what a good support experience is, and fluent English for everyday work. Experience using support insights to change a product team's roadmap. German language skills. Flexibility and Trust: Our work environment thrives on flexibility and trust. We offer fully remote work set-up with opportunities for in-person collaboration. You can manage your working hours flexibly because we prioritize the results you deliver over the number of hours you put in. An International Diverse Team: Our team is a mosaic of over 248 individuals hailing from 50+ different countries and working across 15+ diverse locations. We take pride in our openness and inclusivity. Continuous Growth and Career Development: We invest in your growth with company-wide access to LinkedIn Learning and curated learning paths. From day one, you have the chance to contribute your ideas and create a meaningful impact. Our flat hierarchies and swift decision-making processes provide an open platform for your career progression. Competitive Benefits Package: Annual compensation reviews to ensure you're rewarded fairly. A remote office set-up bonus to enhance your workspace. An employee assistance program, offering resources and counseling. raw.description:
About Jimdo

We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses.

Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world.

We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward.

At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward.

Role Overview

At Jimdo, we think the best support is the one a customer never needs. When our customers, self-employed people and small business owners, do need help, it should come fast: from self-service and AI first, and from a person when that's what the case needs.

We're bringing our support tooling, Zendesk, chatbots and AI work together into one team with one backlog and one roadmap. As Senior Product Owner, you'll lead that team and own the outcome: more questions answered by AI, faster help, lower cost to serve, and customers who still trust us.

You'll also shape where this goes next. Over the next couple of years AI will handle more and more first-line support, and you'll decide how the work is split between AI and people, and build the platform around it.

 

The team and who you'll work with

You'll report to the Head of Customer Support Services and join CSS, our support organisation.

You'll lead a small team of Zendesk and AI specialists and work day to day with the engineers who build our support tools.

You'll work closely with our knowledge and readiness team, support agents and team leads, product teams, our Company AI team, Data & Analytics, and our support and AI vendors.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Set the vision for our support platform and AI with the Head of CSS, and turn it into a roadmap, a business case and results.

  • Lead, coach and grow your team, and bring specialists and engineers together around one backlog and clear quarterly outcomes.

  • Own how well our chatbot, Zendesk AI agents and Copilot perform: define what a good AI answer is, measure it, and switch off what doesn't help customers.

  • Improve routing, user identification and self-service entry points so customers get to the right answer faster.

  • Spend real time with customers and support agents: read tickets, listen to chats, see where people get stuck.

  • Build a written case for every bigger piece of work, own the cost to serve, and check results against your forecast.

  • Turn what you learn in support into evidence that helps product teams fix problems at the source.

Your first months

  • After 3 months: your team works from one backlog and one outcome roadmap, and the quality bar for AI answers is agreed.

  • After 6 months: you've delivered and reported your first quarterly outcome, including how AI resolution compares with your forecast.

What you bring to the table

  • 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally including support, CX, service or internal platform products.

  • You've shipped AI or chatbot features in production and can name the metric you moved, the baseline and the result.

  • You explain product decisions in commercial terms: cost, savings, effect, and what you learned when a forecast was wrong.

  • You've managed people and led people who didn't report to you, ideally across departments.

  • You do your own analysis with SQL or BI tools, and design and read experiments without waiting for an analyst.

  • A clear point of view on what a good support experience is, and fluent English for everyday work.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Zendesk (or a similar tool such as Intercom or Salesforce Service Cloud), including AI agents, routing and automations.

  • Experience using support insights to change a product team's roadmap.

  • German language skills.

What we offer:

Inspiring Mission: At our core, we are driven by a meaningful mission - to  empower solopreneurs and small businesses to succeed and  to contribute to the sustainability and vibrancy of the communities they serve.

Flexibility and Trust: Our work environment thrives on flexibility and trust. We offer fully remote work set-up  with opportunities for in-person collaboration. You can manage your working hours flexibly because we prioritize the results you deliver over the number of hours you put in. 

An International Diverse Team: Our team is a mosaic of over 248 individuals hailing from 50+ different countries and working across 15+ diverse locations. We take pride in our openness and inclusivity.

Continuous  Growth and Career Development: We invest in your growth with company-wide access to LinkedIn Learning and curated learning paths. From day one, you have the chance to contribute your ideas and create a meaningful impact. Our flat hierarchies and swift decision-making processes provide an open platform for your career progression.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. YOUR IMPACT As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, analysis, validation and realisation of Proxima’s Alpha stellarator fusion machine. Your innovative and detailed engineering work will deliver robust mechanical, structural, and thermal performance of critical systems, tooling and manufacturing processes. You will also work with external collaborators and suppliers to develop the designs, equipment, systems and materials that will enable Proxima’s mission to deliver clean, sustainable fusion energy. WHAT YOU WILL DO Develop innovative solutions and detailed mechanical designs for significant systems within the Alpha stellarator, ensuring integration with the broader physics, mechanical and structural systems. Carry out thermal and structural analysis and assessment of mechanical designs, providing design input and implementing recommended design improvements. Conduct technology trade-offs, materials selections and feasibility studies to facilitate the successful identification of the Alpha net energy stellarator. Design, deliver, and support the prototyping and verification of the components, materials, assemblies and manufacturing processes selected for Alpha. Work with external suppliers and collaborators to assist and guide the development and manufacture of the components and systems that will come together to demonstrate the net energy Alpha stellarator. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR High performers with excellent communication and problem-solving skills who love challenges and are not afraid to experiment, take risks, and learn from mistakes. Experience in designing and analysing mechanical components and assemblies, with proficiency in CAD (experience with 3DExperience/CATIA v6 and ANSYS is highly beneficial, but not essential). Experience in designing and delivering the conceptual and detailed design of mechanical, structural, thermal or electro-mechanical equipment, particularly for use in research, development, prototyping and manufacturing. Knowledge and experience of designing and selecting materials for some or all of the following engineering applications: high temperature, cryogenic, electromagnetic, vacuum. Demonstrated ability to work with and manage external suppliers, with multidisciplinary technical teams in fast-paced, dynamic settings. Proficiency with programming languages used in science and engineering (particularly Python) is highly beneficial but not essential. INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-45 min) Portfolio Presentation & Review (45-60 min) Technical Panel Interviews (2x60 min) CEO call (30 min) Successful applicants will be assigned to one of the Engineering teams within Proxima, depending on their specific skills, location, and the needs of the organisation. This role sits at L2/L3/L4 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. description: <h2><strong>About the role: What's in the Box</strong></h2> <p>In this role you will be part of the Global Price &amp; Discount Strategy Team, shaping pricing and discount strategy across our full global portfolio which includes our core brand, HelloFresh, as well as: Factor, GreenChef, EveryPlate, Chef's Plate, and Youfoodz. Retention Economics: </strong><span style="text-align: justify;">Lead incentive strategy and impact modeling to drive performance of our emerging loyalty program and churn prevention initiatives.</span></li> <li><strong>Advanced Testing &amp; Analysis:</strong> Own the full AB testing lifecycle from hypothesis generation and test setup to execution and post-test analysis to constantly refine our incentive models.</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven Optimization:</strong> Identify opportunities to improve current global strategies through deep-dive analysis, increasing customer lifetime value while balancing top and bottom-line growth.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Engagement:</strong> Partner with and influence senior leadership and global teams (e.g., Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Analytics) in setting strategy roadmaps and sharing recommendations that drive impactful decision-making.</li> <li><strong>Playbook Development:</strong> Establish and refine best practices and playbooks to ensure a consistent, scalable approach to pricing and discount initiatives across all markets.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring: The Ingredients&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in Business/Management, Business Analytics, Economics or any related field.</li> <li>4-6 years of professional experience in pricing strategy, consulting, analytics, or a subscription-based business model.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and advanced command of Excel with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, additional SQL-knowledge is a plus.</li> <li>Extensive experience devising and measuring the effectiveness of discount strategies (including AB testing), with a proven track record from other data-rich business environments.</li> <li>Outstanding written and verbal communication skills including the ability to lead effective meetings and presentations with senior management.</li> <li>Track record of end-to-end project ownership in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Outstanding attention to detail to ensure analysis accuracy.</li> </ul> <p class="p1">Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. title: Senior Group Marketing Controller (All Genders)
description: <h1><strong>The role</strong></h1> <p style="text-align: justify;">The Group Marketing Controller is the primary finance interface for HelloFresh's global marketing function. The role exists to ensure marketing spend is planned accurately, closed correctly, and reported transparently — bridging the gap between marketing execution and the Group P&amp;L.</p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Above all, we are looking for people who will <strong>make HelloFresh</strong> <strong>better.</strong> We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! Close &amp; Accruals</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the month-end close process for marketing cost lines across all markets</li> <li>Review and validate marketing accruals submitted by local finance teams</li> <li>Identify and resolve booking errors, misclassifications, or missing accruals</li> <li>Maintain clean actuals in the income statement for all marketing line items</li> <li>Work with SE Finance Controlling to improve and create transparency to the markets on marketing IC charges</li> </ul> <h3><strong>2. Budget &amp; Forecast Management</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Consolidate and challenge market-level marketing budgets during planning cycles</li> <li>Lead marketing Guidance creation for Business Plan cycles</li> <li>Maintain the Group marketing budget with actuals vs. budget vs. forecast</li> <li>Flag material variances early and escalate to marketing stakeholders</li> </ul> <h3><strong>3. Reporting &amp; Analysis</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Work with Tech and local markets to improve and automate input quality of weekly reporting</li> <li>Produce monthly marketing performance reports covering spend vs. budget, phasing, and key variance drivers (Leverage A.I. and Databricks Dashboards)</li> <li>Support the CFO/board reporting pack with accurate marketing cost commentary</li> <li>Build and maintain performance reports for Global Marketing teams</li> </ul> <h3><strong>4. Business Partnering</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the day-to-day finance contact for the Global Marketing teams</li> <li>Manage Direct and Indirect spend for the Marketing team</li> </ul> <h3><strong>5. Process &amp; Controls</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Document and improve the end-to-end marketing close process</li> <li>Ensure consistent cost treatment across markets (e.g. working vs. non-working spend, agency fees, media)</li> <li>Identify gaps in how marketing costs are captured and propose fixes</li> </ul> <h4><strong>WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Clean marketing close every month — no material restatements or late accruals</li> <li>Stakeholders can trust the marketing numbers without re-checking them</li> <li>Variances are explained proactively, not reactively</li> <li>Marketing controller processes are standardised across markets</li> </ul> <h4><strong>WHAT THE FUTURE LOOKS LIKE</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Manage marketing spend between markets by reviewing ROI, AOR and agreed upon KPI performance</li> <li>Centralised and automated marketing controlling at month-end</li> </ul> <h4><strong>WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Not a marketing strategist — not expected to have opinions on campaign effectiveness or brand direction</li> <li>Not a data analyst — analytical support comes from the Finance Systems team; this role translates outputs into financial conclusions</li> <li>Not a local market controller — this role holds the Group view; local controllers own their market execution</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Several years of experience in financial controlling, FP&amp;A, or a similar finance business-partnering role, ideally with exposure to marketing or performance-marketing cost structures</li> <li>Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfort working with large datasets and BI/reporting tools</li> <li>Ability to explain financial variances clearly to non-finance stakeholders</li> <li>Experience running or supporting a month-end close process</li> <li>Comfort operating across multiple markets and currencies in a fast-paced, matrixed organisation</li> <li>Curiosity about how AI and automation can modernise financial reporting</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What we offer</strong></h1> <p>Elevate your lifestyle! From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Are you up for the challenge?</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.</span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.&nbsp;</span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4>Student Labs: Constructor Fabric Research Edition</h4> <p><strong>Curious how AI is changing the way software is built? Want to explore it hands-on, guided by the researchers who work on it every day?</strong></p> <p>Constructor Tech and Constructor Labs, together with Constructor University, invite you to <strong>Student Labs</strong>: a 2-month educational research program for BSc and MSc students.</p> <p>This edition is dedicated to <strong>Constructor Fabric</strong>, a shared AI and software platform. Fabric brings together reusable building blocks, common infrastructure and AI agents that help design, build and test software.</p> <h5>🚀 Why Constructor Fabric?</h5> <p>AI-native software platforms are one of the <strong>fastest-growing fields in tech</strong>, and few students get to study one from the inside. Student Labs gives you that chance. You explore open research questions on a platform in active development, learn current research methods, and build skills that are in high demand in industry and academia.</p> <h5>🔬 What you can research</h5> <h5>&nbsp;</h5> <p><strong>AI that builds software</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Domain-specific languages (DSL):</strong> how a formal language can describe software components so that AI can generate and regenerate them from specifications</li> <li><strong>Neurosymbolic models:</strong> combining neural networks with logic and rules, so that AI-generated code can be checked, not just produced</li> <li><strong>Rule extraction and fine-tuning:</strong> how to extract rules and knowledge from existing code and use them to adapt language models</li> <li><strong>World models:</strong> how AI systems build an internal model of their environment to understand, plan and predict</li> <li><strong>Formal verification:</strong> mathematical methods that prove software behaves as specified</li> <li><strong>Geometric models:</strong> using geometry to represent data and help AI models learn from it</li> <li><strong>Benchmarking:</strong> how to measure fairly whether one AI model or method is really better than another</li> </ul> <p><strong>Next-generation language models</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Diffusion models for text:</strong> today’s LLMs write one token at a time, which makes them slow and prone to hallucinations. Diffusion models generate whole passages at once. Explore how to make them match and beat today’s models.</li> <li><strong>LLM security:</strong> how to host large language models securely when many users and organisations share the same system</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h5>💡 What you’ll experience</h5> <ul> <li>Explore an open research question that matches your level: beginner, intermediate or advanced</li> <li>Learn from weekly mentoring sessions with Constructor researchers and engineers</li> <li>Exchange ideas with other students, and study solo or in a pair</li> <li>Present your results as a research report, prototype or research concept</li> </ul> <h5>🎓 Who can apply?</h5> <ul> <li>BSc and MSc students of Constructor University and our partner universities</li> <li>Students with a strong interest in AI, LLMs, software engineering or research. Beginners are welcome!</li> </ul> <h5>👉 How it works</h5> <ol> <li><strong>Choose a topic</strong> from a curated list proposed by our researchers.</li> <li><strong>Find your level.</strong> Topics are offered for beginner, intermediate and advanced students, so everyone can find one that fits.</li> <li><strong>Study solo or in a pair</strong>, depending on the topic.</li> <li><strong>Lead your own research</strong> and set your own schedule, with weekly guidance from your mentor.</li> <li><strong>Present your results</strong> and receive feedback and a certificate of completion.</li> </ol> <h5>⭐ Why join?</h5> <ul> <li><strong>Study a fast-growing field</strong> from inside a real AI platform</li> <li><strong>Learn from experts:</strong> weekly mentorship from researchers and engineers</li> <li><strong>Earn academic credit:</strong> depending on your university’s rules, the Labs can count towards your mandatory internship, earn you project credits, or become part of your thesis</li> <li><strong>Publish:</strong> strong results can be published, with you as an author</li> <li><strong>Build your research portfolio</strong> and receive a certificate</li> <li><strong>Next steps:</strong> thesis co-supervision, and you can apply for paid internships in the Constructor ecosystem (separate application)</li> </ul> <p>📅 <strong>Duration:</strong> 2 months<br>📍 <strong>Format:</strong> remote, or hybrid in Bremen (DE), Sofia (BG) or Belgrade (RS)<br>🗓 <strong>Mentoring:</strong> weekly sessions with your mentor. About 10–15 hours a week; you set your own schedule.</p> <p><em>Student Labs is an educational research program, not a job or an internship. Participation is unpaid and voluntary.</em></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Design System Engineer (f/m/d)
description: ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities. Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations. Your tasks: Evolve, expand and maintain our component libraries on all our platforms (iOS, Android and Web): Angular, Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI fed by a shared design system. Partner closely with our UI/UX designers on component APIs, naming, states, and variants, keeping our code in sync with our Figma library - closing the gap between what is designed and what ships. Define the system's architecture: theming and brand layering, versioning, releases, and a contribution model that invites our domain teams in rather than shutting them out. Maintain living documentation (e.g. Storybook) and drive adoption through pairing, reviews, and migration paths. Make accessibility and responsive behavior built-in properties of our components, not an afterthought. Adopt agentic coding practices and use AI coding agents to accelerate development, while maintaining ownership of technical decisions, code quality, and outcomes. What you offer us: Several years as a frontend or mobile engineer, including hands-on ownership of a design system or shared component library used by multiple teams. TypeScript and Angular skills or comparable depth in another modern framework / library and a clear willingness to go all in on Angular plus a sharp instinct for component API design. Hands-on native UI development with Kotlin/Jetpack Compose or Swift/SwiftUI. You will author native components yourself. Strong expertise in one platform, combined with an interest in developing a working knowledge of the other, is perfectly fine. Experience with design tokens and theming multi-brand environments: building one system that carries several brands without forking. A strong grasp of responsive and adaptive design and of accessibility standards, and the habit of verifying both in practice. A product mindset toward internal tooling, you treat the design system and component libraries as a product with users and measure success by adoption. You enjoy enabling other teams and building consensus across engineering and design. What we offer: State-of-the-art technologies and an agile environment (Check our Tech Radar: https://lotto24.github.io/tech-radar/ ) A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company. A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact. Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development. Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel. Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results. Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance. Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool. Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program. Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security. Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany. Quarterly company events, along with regular team activities and informal gatherings, a favorite being our Healthy Tuesday lunches or Treat Thursdays in the office! Sounds exciting? Great! We're looking forward to receiving your online application. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe. What you'll own as our Senior AI Product Designer You'll own end-to-end design for one of our core product areas, on a platform where AI is the foundation of the product, not a bolt-on feature. Your mission is to bring consumer-grade craft to a B2B healthcare product used by clinicians and hospital administrators under real time pressure, and to help invent the design patterns for AI-native surfaces that don't exist anywhere else yet. You design the AI-native surfaces our platform is built around, including multi-modal interfaces, agent state, uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop controls, inventing the patterns as you go rather than adapting existing ones. You own end-to-end design for a product area – Discharge Core, Voice Desktop, Extract & Docs, Patient Overview, or Agent – taking work from a messy problem statement through to what ships in production. You contribute to our design system, building the components and AI-specific conventions that other designers and teams build on. You partner closely with product and engineering, shaping technical and product direction rather than being handed a spec to execute against. You work with other designers across the organisation, bringing your input and influence beyond your own product area rather than staying inside a single team's boundary. You hold a high craft bar in critique, lifting the standard of what the wider design team ships. You help hold coherence across our AI Suite (Voice, Docs, Extract, Agent) and Discharge Core, so a fast-growing multi-product platform still feels like one product to the people using it. How we design: We're AI-native. We use AI tools daily in our own process, not just in what we design, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well. Consumer-grade craft is the bar, even in B2B. Our users are clinicians and hospital administrators. Human-in-the-loop by default. This is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and verification moments that make that real, not just a confidence score bolted on. We ship in production, not just in Figma. Craft is judged by what clinicians actually use, so we stay close to what ships. What to expect as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d): Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you. Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement. Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs. Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off. Here's how we picture you as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d): You have 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years operating at Senior, Principal, or Staff altitude. You have designed for AI and non-determinism before, and can talk concretely about how you've communicated agent behaviour, handled errors, and kept users in control, not just in the abstract. You have owned or significantly contributed to a design system, at the level of patterns and principles rather than individual components. You are block-shaped: equally strong across UX process, UI craft, product thinking, research, storytelling, and cross-functional collaboration. You have taken features from 0 to 1 through an ambiguous problem statement to shipped code, and you're comfortable feeling like a PM or frontend developer on the days that calls for it. You have high agency and spot gaps without being asked to look for them, including outside your own product area. You hold a position under pressure but change it when new information warrants, rather than becoming precious about your own decisions. You communicate confidently in English and are comfortable operating in an international environment; German is a plus but not required. You bring a consumer-grade craft background with exceptional design; healthtech experience is a plus but not required. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.</p> <p>You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. title: Analytics Lead, Full Stack
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p>We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical individual to join our Growth Analytics International team. This team plays a crucial role in conducting research, monitoring performance, and running experiments to develop exceptional products for both consumers and merchants while driving long-term growth for the business. As Affirm continues expanding into new international markets, this role will be instrumental in establishing the operational analytics framework for new launches, beginning with Australia and expanding into future international markets. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, a collaborative mindset, an eagerness to learn, and the patience to tackle complex challenges.</p> <p>Our team takes an end-to-end business analytics perspective, partnering across the organization to develop recommendations and solutions that enable the business to successfully execute its growth and profitability strategies. This role requires someone who can combine analytical rigor with business acumen to influence decisions and drive measurable outcomes.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish and evolve the operational analytics framework for new international markets, ensuring scalable measurement, reporting, and decision-making capabilities as we expand globally.</li> <li>Operate with a business owner mindset by proactively identifying opportunities through analysis and product sense to enhance user experience, growth, and profitability.</li> <li>Own business problems from end to end by translating analytical insights into recommendations and optimization strategies that support business growth, profitability, and operational excellence.</li> <li>Take ownership of the end-to-end analytics process: define success metrics, generate insights and hypotheses, track performance, and create intuitive dashboards and reports that can be easily shared across the organization. Develop scalable analytics solutions and data models.</li> <li>Tackle ambiguous problems by identifying the core hypotheses and designing actionable experiments to validate product-market fit and economic viability.</li> <li>Translate analytical findings into clear and compelling narratives and business cases for leadership to inform decision-making.</li> <li>Spearhead weekly cross-functional metric reviews, collaborating with partners to conduct deep dives into significant metric shifts and suggest actionable steps.</li> <li>Partner effectively across Product, Risk, Finance, Commercial, and Operations to align strategies and execute against business objectives.</li> <li>Foster strong cross-functional relationships and establish yourself as a trusted advisor to team members.</li> <li>Mentor and guide junior analysts to deliver high-impact work that drives business results.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Passion to redefine the lending and financial industry for the better.</li> <li>Strong understanding of the consumer lending and credit industry, including lending economics, portfolio performance, and credit metrics. Experience supporting international lending markets, particularly Europe and/or APAC, is highly desirable.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to balance growth objectives with profitability and develop data-driven growth strategies.</li> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitatively rigorous subject area such as statistics, mathematics, finance, or economics.</li> <li>5+ years of proven success in a cross-functional analytical role.</li> <li>Practical and theoretical knowledge of A/B testing.</li> <li>Experience with SQL and performing statistical analysis using Python.</li> <li>Experience simultaneously balancing multiple workstreams and prioritizing an analytics roadmap.</li> <li>Demonstrated curiosity and a growth mindset, with hands-on experience using AI-powered tools such as Cursor, Claude, or similar assistants to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, enhance problem-solving, and advocate for AI adoption across analytical workflows.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Comfortable partnering across multiple cross-functional teams, particularly Product, Risk, Commercial, Finance, and Operations.</li> <li>Ability to think creatively and critically while thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic, and often ambiguous work environment.</li> <li>Willingness to go out of your way to help teammates, with humility and a team-first mindset.</li> <li>Previous experience mentoring and guiding junior analysts.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits</strong></h4> <p><strong>Pay Grade</strong> - M<br><strong>Equity Grade</strong> - 5<br><br>Employees new to Affirm typically come in <strong>at the start of the pay range</strong>. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.&nbsp;<br><br>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).<br><br>GBR base pay range per year: <strong>£113,000 - £161,000 &nbsp;<br></strong><br>Location - <strong>Remote UK</strong></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong>Remote-first with flexibility built in</strong><strong><br></strong>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.</p> <p><strong>Benefits designed for you</strong><strong><br></strong>Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:</p> <ul> <li>Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.</li> <li>Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.</li> <li>Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.</li> <li>Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.</li> </ul> <p>We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.</p> <p>For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a> and consent to the use of your personal information as described.</p> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>About Physical AI</strong></p> <p>CoreWeave's Physical AI team helps companies apply AI to the physical systems they design, test, and operate, across automotive, industrial, robotics, and autonomous vehicles (AV).</p> <p>We work as one cross-functional team of product, design, engineering, and forward-deployed engineers, partnering directly with our customers' engineering teams.</p> <p>Our focus is twofold: making AI usable for engineers who know their machines in depth but are not ML specialists, and supporting robotics and AV teams across the full development loop, from sensor data and simulation to model training and evaluation.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Staff Product Designer</strong> on the Physical AI team, you will lead design across our portfolio of Physical AI products, turning complex data and ML workflows into tools that engineers who build vehicles, machines, and robots trust and use every day. You'll bring strong design craft and sharp product judgment to a new product area, setting direction and framing ambiguous problems.</p> <p>This is a role with real breadth. You'll own the end-to-end experience across a number of products, from the customer-facing apps engineers use day to day to the builder tools our Field team use to create and publish those apps. You'll set a shared design vision for the portfolio and consolidate our Physical AI products into the broader CoreWeave design language, so they reuse proven patterns and feel like part of one platform. You'll also spend time with customer engineering teams to understand their workflows, data, and constraints, turning what you learn into clear problem framing for Product and Engineering.</p> <p>We're looking for a designer who uses AI tools as a core part of their workflow today, to prototype, test ideas, and explore more options in less time. Comfort with technical complexity and a bias toward experimentation are essential here.</p> <p>As the most senior designer on the Physical AI team, you'll mentor the designers you work alongside, raise the craft bar, and shape how design works with Product, Engineering, and Field Engineering. You'll be joining a small, high-trust design team. The work is broad, the impact is real, and there's room to shape how design operates at one of the fastest-growing infrastructure companies in the world.</p> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience as a versatile designer who can own all facets of design, including user research, UX, interaction design, prototyping, and UI design.</li> <li>An excellent portfolio showcasing user-centered problem solving through interaction design, visual design, and systems thinking.</li> <li>Deep proficiency with Figma and a solid understanding of building usable, accessible, and modular designs that scale.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to define strategy and solve complex problems for technical users in B2B, infrastructure, developer tools, or platform contexts.</li> <li>Actively incorporates AI tools into your design workflow, using them to move faster, prototype smarter, and tackle harder problems.</li> <li>Comfortable working with technical complexity and ambiguity; you help teams frame problems, not just resolve them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, or modern frameworks for prototyping or implementation.</li> <li>Familiarity with ML concepts such as training, evaluation, and deployment, or with simulation and test workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure or enterprise platform products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Care deeply about users:</strong> You love connecting with real users daily, helping them solve issues and understand good patterns for using our tools. You approach questions and requests with a kind, thoughtful tone that makes users feel appreciated and connected to our team.</li> <li><strong>Autonomous:</strong> You work well in a self-directed environment, proactively finding ways to improve processes and collaborate with team members or engaged users.</li> <li><strong>Curious and driven:</strong> You are eager to explore machine learning and learn more about the engineering stack and common ML workflows, solving problems in both fast-paced, short-term sprints and in larger, long-term projects.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why Us?</strong></h3> <p>We work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution&nbsp;</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Critical Illness Cover&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme&nbsp;</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. title: Programme Manager, Cloud Services DevOps
description: <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Why Verifone</span></h2> <p>For more than 30 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.</p> <p>Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.</p> <p>Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located.</p> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">What's Exciting About the Role</span></h2> <p>Verifone is offering a unique opportunity to step into a newly created role and help shape the future of our global cloud operations. As our Programme Manager, Cloud Services DevOps, you'll oversee our enterprise-wide cloud services and infrastructure transformation initiatives. You will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy, financial planning and technical execution.&nbsp;You will work across cross-functional engineering teams, manage delivery and governance, and optimize our continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) and cloud hosting environments (AWS/Azure).</p> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Key Responsibilities</span></h2> <p data-pm-slice="1 3 []"><strong>Programme &amp; Delivery Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>End-to-End Ownership: Take full accountability for the delivery of complex cloud, infrastructure, and automation programmes from inception to completion</li> <li>Governance &amp; Reporting: Implement robust project governance, track budgets, manage RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs, and report progress to senior stakeholders</li> <li>Resource Allocation: Coordinate with onshore and offshore engineering teams, defining roles, workflows, and deliverables schedules</li> <li>Cross-Functional Collaboration: Facilitate communication between software development, IT operations, finance, security, and external clients</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical &amp; DevOps Oversight&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Cloud Strategy: Oversee the management and scaling of multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or Private Cloud)</li> <li>Automation &amp; CI/CD: Ensure adherence to best practices in infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and automated deployment pipelines using tools like Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins</li> <li>Operational Security: Embed security standards (DevSecOps), compliance requirements, and ITIL frameworks into the core delivery lifecycle</li> <li>Performance Optimization: Monitor platform reliability, uptime targets (SLAs), and logging/monitoring frameworks</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Required Skills and Qualifications</span></h2> <ul> <li>Proven track record of managing enterprise-scale cloud transformation or DevOps programmes</li> <li>Strong background working in Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery models within fast-paced environments</li> <li>Budget management experience and familiarity with tracking toolsets (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira, MS Project)</li> <li>Technical competencies</li> <li>3<sup>rd</sup> party vendor collaboration</li> <li>Deep conceptual or hands-on understanding of cloud architecture (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, containerization/Kubernetes)</li> <li>Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps)</li> <li>Awareness of infrastructure automation and configuration management tools (Terraform, Ansible)</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Soft Skills and Leadership</span></h2> <ul> <li>Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills to articulate technical solutions to non-technical audiences</li> <li>Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities to guide engineering teams through operational change</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Our Commitment</span></h2> <p>Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game.
