title: Data Platform Manager
description: About the role As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week. You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver. At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive. What You'll Do Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people. Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do. Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source. Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business. Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence. Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge. Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question. Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake. Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us. Requirements What You’ll Need Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field. 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's. Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously. Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does. Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams. Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope. Experience leading engineers — formally, or as a technical lead who set direction and mentored others. A first step into people management is welcome if the technical leadership is already there. Proven integration experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, as well as APIs, flat-file landings, and change data capture from operational databases. Solid data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling and an understanding of how a semantic layer serves Power BI. Working knowledge of lineage, data governance, and access control in a cloud platform; exposure to Microsoft Purview is a plus. Interest or experience in the data foundations behind AI assistants — retrieval, knowledge graphs, and preparing data so that an agent can answer with it. Aerospace or another regulated industry is an advantage; so is experience in a start-up or scale-up. Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus. Who You Are You are an architect who never stops building. You have strong opinions about how a platform should be structured, and you earn the right to them by being in the code. You would rather make a design decision explicit and documented than let it live in one person's head. You care more about reliability than novelty. You know that the measure of a data platform is whether people trust the numbers that come out of it on a Monday morning, not how modern the stack looks on a slide. When something breaks, you want to know why it was possible, not just how to patch it. You enjoy growing engineers, and you understand that leading a small team means doing the work alongside them. Above all, you want to build something durable — a foundation that holds while the company scales on top of it.   Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Finance)
description: About the role Every number that reaches our leadership team, our board, and our auditors has to be right the first time — and that is where you come in. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Finance at Destinus, you are the bridge between the owners of our financial data, the CFO, and the wider finance team and the data in our lakehouse. You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it. This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants. At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). We are a fast-growing international group operating across several European entities, and the standards we hold our financial data to are rising just as quickly. Join us in building a finance reporting foundation that is accurate, traceable, and ready for any question asked of it. What You'll Do Be the go-to contact between the business owners of finance data — the CFO, accounts payable and receivable, and treasury — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on. Build and maintain Power BI dashboards covering cash flow, receipts and collections, payables, and spend across the group, built on certified lakehouse data. Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for finance: specify the tables, fields, and business rules — entities, currencies, financial dimensions, intercompany — and validate the result against the ledger before anyone relies on it. Prepare and quality-check entity-level data extractions from our lakehouse and ERP in support of the external audit, and keep audit requests tracked from request to delivery. Define and document finance KPI definitions in our KPI catalog — formulas, inclusions, exclusions, owners, and sources — to a standard that withstands external review. Describe our finance data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first. Automate what is manual today: turn recurring spreadsheet work, audit packs, and month-end routines into repeatable processes that largely run themselves. Improve the finance processes and system configuration that create the data, working with the finance team and our ERP specialists, so that issues are fixed at source rather than corrected every month. Help the finance team get more from the tools through training and self-service, so they can answer their own questions. Requirements What You’ll Need Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Economics, or a related field. A genuine finance background is essential — experience in external or internal audit, controlling, financial reporting, or FP&A. This is not a data role with finance on the side; you need to understand the accounting behind the figures. Confident with general ledger and subledger structures, trial balances, accounts payable and accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and the principles of IFRS. Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills. Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back. Able to explain data to finance colleagues and accounting logic to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance is a strong advantage — the general ledger, accounts payable and accounts receivable modules, and the data structures underneath them. We run on D365, and someone who already knows it will be effective months earlier. An interest in improving how the system is configured and used matters as much as knowing where to click. A track record of simplifying or automating a process, not only reporting on it. Experience supporting an external audit, or working in a multi-entity, multi-currency international group, is a strong advantage. Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus. Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred. Who You Are You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one. You are not content to rebuild the same report every month. When something is manual, repetitive, or fragile, your instinct is to go upstream and fix it rather than absorb it. You enjoy working with finance colleagues who ask hard questions, and you would rather be challenged on a detail than have it slip through. Above all, you want your work to be relied on, by the CFO, by the board, and by anyone who audits it.   Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

We run on D365, and someone who already knows it will be effective months earlier. An interest in improving how the system is configured and used matters as much as knowing where to click.
  • A track record of simplifying or automating a process, not only reporting on it.
  • Experience supporting an external audit, or working in a multi-entity, multi-currency international group, is a strong advantage.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred.

Who You Are

You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one.

You are not content to rebuild the same report every month. When something is manual, repetitive, or fragile, your instinct is to go upstream and fix it rather than absorb it. You enjoy working with finance colleagues who ask hard questions, and you would rather be challenged on a detail than have it slip through.

Above all, you want your work to be relied on, by the CFO, by the board, and by anyone who audits it.

As Head of Product, you lead that shift. You build the product management practice for the BLP Platform from an early stage. Our first product managers are joining stream-aligned teams, starting with Invoice and Procurement, and the team will grow to 4–5 PMs as we expand. You hire them, coach them, and set the standard for what great product work looks like at BLP. You report to the CTO and work closely with Engineering, Projects, Sales, and our founders. Transfer product knowledge out of the experts’ heads and into the teams, without losing the domain depth that got us here. Build the direct line between our teams and our customers. Make our data usable for product decisions. We have BigQuery, PostHog, and prediction-rate analytics available, and we want product managers who reach for them by default. Shape how the product organization works as we grow: intake, prioritization, roadmapping, and the operating rhythm. Contribute directly to product strategy for the platform. What you bring 10+ years in product management, including experience leading or formally coaching product managers, with a real point of view on how product people are developed. Experience working in an empowered product model, where teams were assigned problems to solve rather than features to build. A track record of shipping enterprise B2B software that customers actually adopted. Experience moving an organization toward an empowered product model, including the political and cultural side of it. The ability to hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives, and to say no in a way that keeps the relationship. raw.title: Security Architect
raw.description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) 

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) 

What we offer you 

  

💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 

🏦 Excellent pension contribution. 

🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. 

⏰ Flexible working hours. 

🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 

🏋️ Free onsite gym. 

🎉 Vibrant, open culture.

We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.</span></p> <p>Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.</p> <p>We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.</p> <p>The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team:</strong> Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Hire, coach and promote, and grow engineers into tech leads.</li> <li><strong>Make agentic development the default path:</strong> Shape how developers and AI agents author, validate and deploy projects, both inside the workspace and from the developer's own coding agent. Design the tools, skills and guardrails so agents get the same safety and auditability as humans.</li> <li><strong>Own the strategy and roadmap:</strong> Partner with Product and Design to set a multi-quarter roadmap for declarative deployment: agentic development, governed deployments and deployment history, enterprise CI/CD, and new resource coverage. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar on execution and operational excellence:</strong> Run a predictable delivery process for a fast-moving, open-source product with frequent releases. Own reliability, on-call health, incident response and the quality bar for a tool customers depend on to ship to production.</li> <li><strong>Treat backward compatibility as a product feature:</strong> Lead engine and configuration migrations without forcing customers through a flag day, and communicate change clearly to customers, the community and field teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead across the platform:</strong> Drive alignment with the many platform teams whose resources and services the framework deploys, and with our sibling teams in Developer Ecosystem (SDKs, CLI, IaC provider, IDE). Make the whole toolchain feel like one product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years managing software engineering teams, and 8+ years of software engineering experience overall.</li> <li>A track record of building and shipping developer tools or platforms used by many external developers or internal teams, such as infrastructure-as-code, deployment or CI/CD systems, CLIs, SDKs, or internal developer platforms.</li> <li>A deep understanding of declarative systems and deployment workflows: plan/apply, state management, drift and reconciliation, environment promotion, GitOps.</li> <li>Enough technical depth to engage on architecture and trade-offs with senior and staff engineers, and to hold a high-quality bar for public, versioned interfaces.</li> <li>Experience leading teams through ambiguity, with competing priorities from customers, partners and platform dependencies, and making clear calls.</li> <li>Strong product sense and a customer-first mindset. You enjoy talking to developers, reading their issues, and turning feedback into roadmap.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication, including with executives, partner teams and an external developer community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stand-out experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Built or led teams on infrastructure-as-code or deployment platforms, e.g. Terraform, Pulumi, AWS CDK / CloudFormation, Kubernetes controllers, Argo CD / Flux / Helm, or Vercel / Netlify-style deploy platforms.</li> <li>Managed an open-source developer tool with an active community and a frequent release cadence.</li> <li>Shipped developer workflows for AI coding agents (CLI-first tooling, agent skills, MCP), or AI-assisted authoring.</li> <li>Have managed managers or multiple teams (~15 to 20+ engineers), owned a multi-year platform strategy, and grown tech leads and managers.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
description: Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place. We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel. And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way. Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey. Want to know more about us? Here you go. Your expedition at Polarsteps - Senior Data & Analytics Engineer Over the past 10+ years, Polarsteps has grown massively through word-of-mouth, thanks to our product and tech department building a top-quality user experience for all our travelers. As our first Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, you'll own the foundation that every data-driven decision at Polarsteps is built on. Product & growth teams run experiments and analyse the data every week, leadership need clear reports for investors, and all of that depends on data that is reliable, modelled and compliant. You'll set the direction for our data platform, bring structure to data governance, and own the data infra that helps our product managers, marketers and data scientists do their job even better. You'll work closely with the Head of Engineering on infrastructure and architecture, and with the Head of Growth and product teams on what the business needs from data. With 20M+ users and ratings of 4.8 and 4.7 on the app stores and features in multiple Google and Apple showcases, we've got an impressive past. But we're even more excited for the future, and you'll play a crucial role in building the data foundation that gets Polarsteps to 100M+ travelers around the globe. Your itinerary What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day. Own the data platform roadmap: set the strategy for our data infrastructure and warehouse, make the build-vs-buy and tooling calls, and oversee execution together with DevOps. Design, build and maintain scalable ingestion pipelines for both internal (product events, back-end data) and external sources (ad platforms, attribution, app store data). Build and maintain a clean, documented modeling layer (e.g. dbt) that serves as the single source of truth for analysts, data scientists and self-serving PMs. Lead data governance: define and enforce event naming and tracking standards, a schema change process, documentation, and dashboard ownership. Embed privacy in the data stack: make sure personal data is categorized, minimized and pseudonymized before it reaches downstream and third-party tools, in close collaboration with Legal Own the health of the stack: monitoring, alerting, data quality checks and cost management, so issues are caught before they reach stakeholders. Define who owns what across our data tooling (e.g. Mixpanel, our warehouse and BI layer), and help teams get the most out of self-serve analytics. Enable data enrichment to unlock deeper insights for Product and Growth. Explore how we can safely use LLMs (such as Claude) on top of our data for analysis and reporting. Act as the go-to data partner for Product, Engineering and Growth, and help grow the data function as Polarsteps scales. The equipment in your backpack What we're hoping you'll bring with you. ✅ 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a hybrid data role, ideally in a B2C product or mobile app company. ✅ Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on experience modeling large event datasets in a modern warehouse (e.g. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift). ✅ Experience with dbt and an orchestration tool such as Airflow or Dagster. ✅ Proven track record of bringing structure to data governance: tracking plans, event ownership, documentation and data quality. ✅ Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Amplitude) and BI tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker). ✅ Comfortable owning infrastructure decisions: cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD for data. ✅ A pragmatic, ownership-driven mindset: you're happy to set the strategy and get your hands dirty, and you enjoy the hygiene work others tend to avoid. ✅ Excellent communication skills: you can explain trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders alike. Bonus points if you have: ✨ Experience with mobile attribution or marketing data (e.g. AppsFlyer, SKAdNetwork, ad platform APIs). ✨ Experience with reverse ETL or CDPs (e.g. RudderStack, Twilio Segment). ✨ Experience with experimentation data and A/B testing infrastructure. ✨ Knowledge of GDPR and handling personal data responsibly in an analytics stack. 1st class Polarsteps extras Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet. A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here. A shiny MacBook to work your magic on. Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person. An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk. 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you). Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar. The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year. A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours! A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips. Delicious daily team lunches. Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away. A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed. Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures. At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better. Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede     Wat ga je doen?   Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn.  Je houdt je bezig met:  Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent;   Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden;  Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data);  Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen;  Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen?    Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie.   Dit is jouw team Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam is een ontwikkelende bouwer met zo'n 220 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij zijn onderdeel van de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed en herkenbaar in groen en geel. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze Campus recruiter!   • Nieuwsgierigheid naar veiligheid in de praktijk, vooral in de bouwsector;

  • Niet bang om je handen uit de mouwen te steken;

  • Proactief, sociaal en je werkt graag samen, maar weet ook zelfstandig je weg te vinden;

  • Beschikbaar vanaf februari 2027 voor minimaal 4 dagen per week.

 

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.</p> <p>You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.</p> <h2><strong>Why this role exists</strong></h2> <p>Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.</p> <p>Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Product contribution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.</li> <li>Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.</li> <li>Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Strategic technical stewardship</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Engage with architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.</li> <li>Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.</li> <li>Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.</li> <li>Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.</li> <li>Identify Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Thought leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Create with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.</li> <li>Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.</li> <li>Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.</li> <li>Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.</li> <li>Experience working with customization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Strongly preferred qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.</li> <li>Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.</li> <li>Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.</li> <li>Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.</li> <li>A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Technologies and domains</strong></h2> <p>Directly relevant technologies and domains include:</p> <ul> <li>Ruby on Rails</li> <li>Go</li> <li>AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC</li> <li>PostgreSQL</li> performance analysis</li> <li>Vue and TypeScript</li> <li>APIs and automation</li> <li>DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What this role is not</strong></h2> <p>This role isn't:</p> <ul> <li>A generic field engineering role.</li> <li>A proof-of-concept factory.</li> <li>A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.</li> <li>A customer-specific customization function.</li> <li>Unbilled Professional Services.</li> <li>A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.</li> <li>An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Success measures</strong></h2> <p>Success in this role may include:</p> <ul> <li>Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.</li> <li>Fixing product bugs or contributing features.</li> <li>Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.</li> <li>Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.</li> <li>Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.</p> <h2><strong>Ideal candidate profile</strong></h2> <p>You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. At HousingAnywhere, we want people to feel supported throughout their stay, with the confidence that comes from knowing what happens next and where to turn when they need help.</p> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Product Designer</strong> to own the <strong>Post Booking experience, with a strong focus on our mobile app</strong>. You will shape how tenants and landlords use HousingAnywhere throughout a tenancy: from preparing for move-in and managing payments to getting support and extending a stay.</p> <p>You’ll bring strong mobile app design experience and product thinking to make these everyday interactions feel simple, intuitive, and reliable—helping turn HousingAnywhere into a trusted companion throughout the rental journey.</p> <ul> <li>Shape the long-term vision for the journey beyond the booking, making HousingAnywhere a trusted part of everyday renting.</li> <li>Design experiences that help tenants and landlords prepare for move-in, manage payments, communicate clearly, and navigate issues with confidence.</li> <li>Explore how we can provide ongoing value throughout a tenancy, including renewals and longer stays.</li> <li>Lead projects from early discovery through launch and iteration.</li> <li>Use qualitative research, behavioural data, and experimentation to make decisions, not opinions.</li> <li>Define success, measure impact, and continuously improve your solutions—connecting customer trust and satisfaction with adoption, retention, and business value.</li> <li>Raise the quality bar across the design team through thoughtful critique and craft.</li> <li>Contribute to our design principles, design system, and the way we build the product.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Your team</strong></p> <p><strong>Collaborate deeply. Design with absolute purpose.</strong></p> <p>You'll work alongside Product, Engineering, Research, and Data as an equal partner to challenge assumptions, validate ideas, and turn ambiguity into a product that genuinely improves people's lives. You'll also collaborate closely with our operational teams to understand where the digital experience meets the realities of moving in and renting a home.</p> <p>We move fast, we think ahead, and we focus on what our audience truly needs. Shipping something we're proud of matters even more. If you thrive on autonomy and solving complex puzzles, we want to hear from you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Your profile</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least 7+ years of experience designing complex digital products.</li> <li>Proven experience designing native mobile apps for iOS and Android.</li> <li>Strong product thinking and problem framing skills.</li> <li>Excellent interaction and visual design craft.</li> <li>Experience in marketplaces, search or discovery products.</li> <li>Experience running discovery and validating ideas.</li> <li>Confidence working with data, metrics and experiments.</li> <li>Experience collaborating closely with engineers and product managers.</li> <li>A portfolio showing not only what you designed – but why.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!</li> <li>Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).</li> <li>Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!</li> <li>1,000 EUR personal development budget.</li> <li>Complete coverage for commuting.</li> <li>Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.</li> <li>Gym membership discount with GoVital or OneFit.</li> <li>Dutch/English classes budget.</li> <li>Variable pension scheme.</li> <li>Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).</li> <li>Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre.&nbsp;</li> <li>Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Security Engineer
description: Security Engineer - Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Security Engineer . Iemand die veel energie krijgt van het opbouwen van een nieuw technisch securitydomein. Een gedreven specialist die graag zelf de regie neemt over de inrichting van moderne tooling en veilige architectuur. Jouw rol Als Security Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de technische beveiliging van onze infrastructuur, interne werkplekken en cloudomgevingen. Je bouwt het securitydomein verder uit en selecteert de juiste tooling voor Dawn. Je beheert de gekozen systemen en richt deze tot in de puntjes in. Daarbij vertaal je complexe techniek naar een gedegen en onderbouwd advies voor verschillende afdelingen. Je vormt hiermee de verbindende brug tussen tech leads, hostingteams en Interne IT. Beleid en compliance pakt het ISO-team op, zo kun jij je volledig op de techniek focussen. Wat je zal gaan doen: Je werkt mee aan en verbetert centrale security-tooling zoals EDR en SIEM. Je werkt hands-on aan kwetsbaarhedenbeheer, actieve detectie, monitoring en het ontwerpen van hardening-standaarden. Je adviseert tech leads en hostingteams over veilige architectuur en helpt hen bij security-initiatieven. Je fungeert als het vaste technische aanspreekpunt voor het SOC en beoordeelt samen escalaties. Je draait mee in de technische analyse bij incidenten en bewaart de rust binnen het crisisteam. Wie ben jij? Je hebt een hbo-denkniveau en bij voorkeur een achtergrond in Cyber Security of Informatica . Je brengt een stevige basis mee in security engineering of infrastructuurbeveiliging. Je bezit hands-on ervaring met moderne security controls, IAM, secure configuration en kwetsbaarhedenmanagement. Kennis van cloudomgevingen zoals AWS en affiniteit met netwerkarchitectuur is een grote pré. Je bent zeer leergierig naar nieuwe technieken en toetst gemaakte keuzes altijd scherp en kritisch. Je zoekt actief de verbinding met collega's om samen de beveiliging naar een hoger niveau te brengen. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels en bent bereid om (hybride) te werken op onze kantoren in Geldermalsen en Hilversum. Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie : Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie : Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact : Je beveiligt cruciale systemen voor Dawn Technology en haar klanten. Salaris : Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €6.000,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen : 25 vakantiedagen om volop te ontspannen. Werkplek & Sfeer : Gezellige werksfeer, flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en verzorgde lunch op kantoor (verschillende locaties maar je bent voornamelijk te vinden in Geldermalsen en Hilversum). Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken : Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding en een fiscaal fietsplan. Pensioen : Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen. Ontwikkeling & Extra's : Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen. Events & Fun : Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen, van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend. Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast . Solliciteren Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit op deze rol, nodigen we je juist uit om te solliciteren. We denken namelijk graag met je mee! Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360 . Have a great day. Dawn Technology. We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment om de match met de rol objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen. title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
description: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren.  Wie ben jij Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.   Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.   Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.   Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.   Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers. Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat. Wat ga je doen Wat breng je mee? Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen. •    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;    Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen; •    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn; •    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee; •    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren; •    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn; •    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving; •    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is; •    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré. Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening. Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is? We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.   •    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support; •    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen; •    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten; •    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening; •    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid; •    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen; •    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams; •    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren; •    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren; •    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur; •    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen; •    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.   Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan. Wat bieden wij Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie. Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf. Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. raw.description:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. 

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.

 
Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.

 
Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

 
Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.

 
Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
•    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
•    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;

•    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
•    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
•    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;

title: Senior R&D Engineer/Projectleider Flight Test and Certification (m/v/x)
description: Ben jij op zoek naar een  uitdagende baan  in de wereld van de lucht- en ruimtevaart? En.....ben je die R&D engineer die helpt civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Door aan vliegtuigen te meten en te testen om alles te weten te komen?  Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie, veiligheid en duurzaamheid? Dan spreken we je graag! Wat ga je doen? Als Senior R&D engineer Flight Test en Certificatie werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen. Om onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers te ondersteunen in het bereiken van hun doelen voer je testen uit en analyseert de resultaten, je toetst wijzigingen aan vliegtuigen aan de regelgeving in het kader van veilig vliegen en je ontwikkelt nieuwe regelgeving om innovatieve technieken te implementeren. Je bedenkt en werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen samen met collega’s en andere R&D instituten in een (inter-) nationale setting. Je leidt projecten, hebt veel klantcontact (intern en extern) en werkt met zelfsturende teams, in wisselende samenstelling. Je voert projectwerk uit, je coördineert werkpakketten en je initieert met je collega’s nieuwe projecten. Het werken bij Koninklijke NLR kenmerkt zich door variatie en dynamische werkverbanden. Onze missie is om nieuwe technologie praktisch en veilig toepasbaar te maken en daarmee de Nederlandse (en Europese) industrie en overheid te helpen om voorop te lopen. We geven goed onderbouwde adviezen aan beleidsbepalers, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers. Wat breng je mee? Afgeronde WO master in een technische richting zoals luchtvaarttechniek, elektrotechniek of informatica; Tenminste 5 jaren relevante werkervaring; Ontwikkeling van lucht- en ruimtevaarttuigen en klimaat neutrale luchtvaart spreken je aan als werkgebieden; De ambitie om expert te worden op het gebied van flight test en certificatie; Affiniteit met werken voor Defensie, en liefst kennis van de Defensie organisatie; Bewezen capaciteiten als projectleider voor grote projecten; In staat zijn om klantenwensen te vertalen en een brug te slaan tussen techniek en operationele impact; Positieve instelling, initiatiefrijk, flexibel, resultaatgericht; Communicatief vaardig in het Nederlands en Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau) Wat bieden wij jou? Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightech omgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé. Verder bieden wij jou onder anderen: 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer; Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA, als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden; De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving De afdeling Flight Test en Certificatie (ASTC) richt zich op het ondersteunen van de Nederlandse overheid (Defensie, EZK, IenW) en markt waarin thema’s als "bescherming van de samenleving" en “Klimaat neutrale luchtvaart” belangrijke uitgangspunten zijn. We voeren experimenten en vliegproeven uit met onze eigen vliegtuigen, geschaalde vliegtuigen en drones. We ondersteunen vliegproeven met vliegtuigen van klanten. Dit kan zijn voor een onderzoeksprogramma’s of om te bewijzen dat we radicale en nieuwe concepten op een veilige manier effectiever en sneller kunnen certificeren. We zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor modificaties aan onze research vliegtuigen en bewijzen dat deze veilig zijn. We zijn georganiseerd in twee marktgeoriënteerde teams, Flight Test Support en Certification Support. Veel collega’s zijn in beide teams actief en werken vaak buiten de afdeling in multi-disciplinair verband. Er worden goede mogelijkheden geboden om je eigen ontwikkeling vorm te geven. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving. Wil jij meer weten? Bel of mail dan met Frank Bax (recruiter) via 0615676915 of Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag  hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons  YouTube kanaal . Solliciteren? Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.   Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
